caption: The drawing depicts a dark, opaque, rectangular glass bottle with rounded shoulders and a short, wide neck. The bottle is oriented upright in the center of a plain, beige background. The glass appears to be a deep brown or olive color with some light reflections indicating a shiny surface. On the visible sides of the bottle, there are embossed designs: one face shows a stylized, ornate vase from which a tall, arching plant with multiple curling leaves and stems emerges; the adjacent, narrower face features a simpler vase with a tall, straight plant or branch with small leaves. The base of the bottle is flat and its top is capped with a matching color. There are a few small, red spots toward the bottom right of the image on the background, but otherwise, the composition is uncluttered with the bottle as the sole object.
title: Bottle
